verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation or hands-on report describing Svelte's dev-server/build error messages, error overlays, or stack-trace quality; the only tangential mention is a community comment that 'fixing dev server errors is a little distracting at times' (svelte-comm-6), which does not support a claim of clear/actionable error messages. 'sv check' (svelte-docs-13) is a CLI linting tool, not evidence about dev-server error clarity.
